summary: This document proposed a new document series, IETF Operational Notes, as a repository for operations documents that are more ephemeral than RFCs but more referenceable than Internet-Drafts. It was an experiment under the RFC 3933 process. It is historic and was replaced by RFC 6393.

eli5.summary: The IETF wanted a middle shelf for notes: less permanent than books, more official than loose papers. This proposed that shelf as a trial. It is now historic.
